connector.name: Verifly
connector.registryDescription: Email verification for AI agents - verify, clean & validate emails; self-onboard + crypto pay
connector.summary: Hosted at verifly.email over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace email.verifly, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.
